head: Enough Phone specs upgrade: 12GB RAM, 256GB and a bigger battery
dek: The Enough Phone, a small Android phone with a 5.3-inch screen funding on Kickstarter, now gets 12GB of RAM instead of 8GB, 256GB of storage instead of 128GB and a 3,850 mAh battery, at no extra cost to backers. The company confirmed the changes to 9to5Google this week.
details: The phone is about the footprint of an iPhone 13 Mini, but thicker, and runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 7500 with a user-replaceable battery, a 50MP rear camera and stock Android or the minimal OdysseyOS, with updates through 2032. Backer tiers are $449 (early bird) and $499, retail is planned at $599, and shipping is estimated for around May 2027. The campaign had about a week left and was mostly funded on 25 November.
where: Kickstarter backers worldwide; shipping estimated around May 2027
means: If you want a small Android phone, the one you back now comes with more memory, storage and battery for the same pledge, but it's a crowdfunded phone that ships next year.
todo: If you're interested, read the Kickstarter page before the campaign ends; crowdfunded phones can be late or change before they ship.
